The container does have a strong chemical smell, but I just put it out in the garage to air out, it's already dissipating. These are good quality brushes, so happy I got them. claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the brushes as soft, high-quality, and a great value for the price.
The included organizer case is appreciated for storage, display, and travel.
Some reviewers note a strong chemical or plastic smell from the container/brushes that fades after airing out.
A few reviewers mention downsides like brushes not being labeled for beginners, bulky handles, or durability/stitching issues.
